title: Remote state preparation of single-partite high-dimensional states in complex Hilbert spaces
summary: High-dimensional quantum systems offer a new playground for quantum information applications due to their remarkable advantages such as higher capacity and noise resistance. We propose potentially practical schemes for remotely preparing four- and eight-level equatorial states in complex Hilbert spaces exactly by identifying a set of orthogonal measurement bases. In these minimal-resource-consuming schemes, both pre-shared maximally and non-maximally entangled states are taken into account.
